title: Freedom Woods Equestrian Center
specs: Three indoor arenas and one large outdoor arena
Facility includes heated 80-stall barn and direct access to forest preserve trails
Sustainable practices including rainwater storage and straw bedding
Children as young as five can begin with lead line lessons
Long pants such as jeans or leggings required (no shorts)
Therapy participants assessed for personalized plan

options.name: Classical Hunt Seat Equitation Lessons
options.detail: Lessons in hunters, jumpers, and equitation disciplines with flexible scheduling.

options.name: Hippotherapy & Adaptive Riding Program
options.detail: Therapy sessions for physical, cognitive, or emotional challenges with personalized plans.

options.name: Horse Boarding - Basic Board
options.detail: Stalls 10x12 and 10x14 with daily turnout, stall cleaning, 3 feedings, and coordinated care.

options.name: Horse Boarding - Full Service
options.detail: Includes tacking, grooming, bathing, tack cleaning, bandaging 6 days per week.

options.name: Full Training Package
options.detail: 6 days per week training rides or lessons, monthly mane pull, trim ears and muzzle.
